manifest.name: API reference
manifest.description: Every route of /api/v1, to read and try
docs.ask_reboot: Restart this box? The picture goes and this page answers nothing for as long as the box takes to come back.
docs.ask_restart: Restart the program on this box? The picture goes for a moment, recording and playback stop, and this page answers nothing until it is back.
docs.ask_shutdown: Switch this box off? The picture goes, and it answers nothing here until somebody turns it on again where it stands.
docs.ask_standby: Put this box into standby? The picture goes off the screen.
docs.no_package: The API reference needs the optional package swagger-ui, which this image does not carry. The description itself is at /api/openapi.json.
docs.not_sent: Not sent: this page asked first and the answer was no.
docs.signin: To sign in, run POST /api/v1/login below. The padlock closes by itself and says who you are; the Authorize dialog is not the way in, because the credential this server issues is a cookie and no script in a browser is allowed to set one.
docs.warn_four: Four calls ask once before they go, as they stop the box or take the picture off the screen, and nothing else does:
docs.warn_live: This box answers while you click here. "Try it out" reaches the running program, not a copy of it: a timer you delete here is gone, and a channel you change here changes on the screen this box is connected to. Everything on this page is sent for real.
